## Summary

I have implemented the enhancement for the image generation API to support reference images for fitting model face-matching. Here's what was done:

### Work Completed:

- **Updated `ImageGenerationRequest` type** (`apps/web/lib/types/image-types.ts`):
  - Added `referenceImage?: string` field with JSDoc documentation for base64 data URL
  - Added `generationType?: 'outfit' | 'fitting-model'` field to distinguish generation types

- **Added `generateFittingModelImage` method** (`apps/web/lib/services/image-generation-service.ts`):
  - New method using OpenRouter's multimodal content format with `type: 'image_url'`
  - Extended 60-second timeout for fitting model generation
  - Proper validation of prompt and reference image (must be base64 data URL)
  - Retry logic with exponential backoff (reuses existing patterns)
  - Text-first content array order per OpenRouter documentation

- **Updated API route** (`apps/web/app/api/generate-image/route.ts`):
  - Extracts `referenceImage` and `generationType` from request body
  - Validates `referenceImage` when `generationType` is 'fitting-model' (must be non-empty, start with 'data:image/')
  - Routes to `generateFittingModelImage()` for fitting-model type, otherwise uses existing `generateOutfitImage()`
  - Increased description length limit to 3000 chars for fitting-model generation

- **Updated `fitting-model-service.ts`** (`apps/web/lib/services/fitting-model-service.ts`):
  - Removed base64 text embedding from prompt (no more `REFERENCE IMAGE:` section with embedded base64)
  - Now passes `referenceImage` and `generationType: 'fitting-model'` as separate API fields
  - Mystery mode (`generateDefaultFittingModel()`) remains unchanged

### Files Changed:
```
apps/web/lib/types/image-types.ts              |  12 +
apps/web/lib/services/image-generation-service.ts | 193 ++
apps/web/app/api/generate-image/route.ts       |  50 +-
apps/web/lib/services/fitting-model-service.ts |   8 - (net)
```

Total: ~255 lines added/modified across 4 files.
